title: Audio Editor & MP3 Editor
summary: Audio Editor & MP3 Editor is more than just an app for extracting audio
description:
Audio Editor & MP3 Editor is more than just an app for extracting audio in various formats from videos of all types—it’s also a powerful audio processing application. It supports lossless conversion of numerous audio formats, volume and speed adjustment, audio merging, audio trimming, audio extraction from videos, and audio noise reduction.

Key Features

【Audio Trimming】Professional trimming precise to the millisecond; import audio from your local music library, customize the trimming range, and edit and create with the clipped audio.
【Audio Splicing/Merging】Easily merge multiple audio files, splice and edit audio tracks to create your desired music file.
【Audio Extraction】Extract audio in MP3 or other formats from short videos, instantly converting video music videos into audio files.
【Format Conversion】Supports conversion between a variety of audio formats including MP3/WAV/AAC/FLAC/M4A/WMA; custom selection of sample rates (96000/44100/32000/22050) is available.
